name: Thunderbird
account: Account Settings ▸ Add Mail Account ▸ Configure manually. Connection security None, Authentication Normal password.
parity: Under Synchronisation & Storage, turn on "Keep messages in all folders for this account on this computer". Without it Thunderbird syncs headers only and wins by not doing the work.
Set mail.server.default.max_cached_connections to match the other clients (5).
reset: Remove the Bench account in Account Settings and quit Thunderbird.
Press Enter here, then add the account again, with the setting above.

layout.note: Default "cards" layout with the Quick Filter bar left open; it stays open across launches, and the list sits below it. 66pt cards, reader to the right. The search field is cleared with its own × and never with select-all and Backspace, and never closed with Escape: Backspace in Thunderbird's message list deletes.

caveats.text: The Quick Filter, Thunderbird's search-as-you-type, looks at sender, recipients and subject by default but not the message body, which is less work than full-text search.
Thunderbird keeps no offline copy of Junk and Trash by default; the other 95% of the mailbox it holds in full.
